name: p8c-setup
p8c-full-tara
eval: go(); A.set('view','first'); A.set('perceive',0); G.dialogue.cam.end?.(); const r=A.do('cast','tara',3.4); A.step(0.9); stop(); const a=G.cast.get('tara'); ({visible:a.group.visible, calls:sample(), kind:a.kind})

name: p8c-talk-tara

name: p8c-close
eval: go(); G.dialogue.close(); A.step(1.0); stop(); ok(!G.dialogue.cam.active,'camera handed back'); 1
